title: Mateu wire schema
description: JSON Schema of the Mateu wire: the response envelope (UIIncrementDto) a backend sends and a renderer reads, and the request (RunActionRqDto) a renderer sends. Open by design — additive within a major, readers ignore unknown members — and nothing is required but the 'type' discriminator, since a member at its default may be omitted.
